_note: The city's other people (src/game/Neutrals.js, src/ai/CivilianBrain.js, src/combat/Teams.js, src/combat/WeaponDrops.js). Civilians: perPlayers civilians per soldier in the match (between min and max), never armed at the start; brave: the share who will pick a gun up off the field and defend themselves with it; groups: the share sheltering together (groupSize), all brave, a gun cache in their shelter now and then (cache); defend: how close (m) an armed stranger may come before an armed civilian opens up (groupDefend for a group at its shelter); health. Bandits: gangs per map size, size members each, armed with guns, holding a turf of radius m against both armies (they don't chase past it). Drops: the chance a dying fighter drops his gun, how long (s) it lies, how many at most.
